check_events.statement: Assume At_M4(a,b) as written on scan007. If A⊂M is downward closed and pairwise compatible, and A_X={Y∈A | X≪Y} is nonempty, then A_X has a least element.
steps: Choose Y0∈A_X. By a, the fiber {Z≤Y0 | X≪Z} has a minimal element Z0.

Downward closure gives Z0∈A. If W≤Z0 and X≪W, then W lies in the same fiber below Y0; minimality forces W=Z0. Therefore Z0 is minimal in its own fiber, so X circle≪Z0 by the live parenthetical definition.
For arbitrary Y∈A_X, repeat a to obtain a minimal Z≤Y. Again Z∈A and X circle≪Z.
Since A is pairwise compatible, Z0 and Z are compatible. Clause b gives Z=Z0. Hence Z0≤Y for every Y∈A_X; Z0 is least.
check_events.outcome: Verified under the explicitly stated closure, compatibility and nonemptiness assumptions. This conditional lemma does not identify an unwritten intended correction to scan006 or assert that its entire domain is identical to A_X.
check_events.effect_on_transcription: None. The written word minimal is retained; it is not replaced by least/plus petit.

S_comparison.scope: Only this already-authorized row was consulted; no other S rows or later manuscript pages were opened.
S_comparison.row_summary: S calls the scan006 At6 incidence hypothesis a slip, proposes X≪F, and cites scan007 At_M4a and the circled-refinement definition.
S_comparison.actual_007_ink: The live a begins Si X≪Y; the live insertion says élément minimal; the live naming parenthesis says posons X circle≪Y si c’est Y. An earlier unconditional least-element assertion and the later words plus petit élément are cancelled.
S_comparison.confirmation: The specific textual cross-reference to refinement X≪Y is confirmed. The new page also confirms that the circled relation is defined in the live revision.
S_comparison.qualification: The scan007 wording is minimal, not an unqualified least-element assertion. Its b clause adds compatible uniqueness. The conditional proof recorded here shows how a and b yield leastness in a nonempty downward-closed pairwise-compatible fiber.
S_comparison.status_of_006_correction: No alteration of the scan006 diplomatic text. That page visibly wrote X◁F with the membership parenthesis; its redundancy proof is already in R1-006-S-At6-incidence-triviality. Scan007 supplies additional support for S’s diagnosis, but an inferred authorial intention remains separate from ink.
